pages.taming: Strike with lightning or channeling trident, then feed 1* $(treat1)

pages.text: Zappets fly in flocks of up to 20 individuals, and commune on large rock formations

Zappets are capable of unleashing a blast of lightning upon incoming enemy projectiles, destroying them in the process (projectiles can be specified to be immune via datapack; tridents are immune by default).$(br2)The owner of a tamed zappet can right-click their zappet to place it on their head. Zappets riding on their owner will not only protect them from projectiles but will also grant them slow-falling.  Crouching or becoming submerged removes the Zappet.
